evals.prompt: Deeply investigate how PostgreSQL implements logical replication failover slots in PG 17. Check official docs and release notes, highlight any prerequisites and gotchas, and write a dossier to docs/research/.
evals.expected_output: A technical research dossier conforming to the progressive-disclosure template, citing PG 17 official documentation, explaining replication slots synchronization, prerequisites, and follow-up vectors.
assertions: A markdown dossier is generated in docs/research/ with date and topic slug
Contains an Executive Brief explaining the mental model of logical failover slots
Primary source index cites official PostgreSQL 17 documentation or release notes
Lists at least 2 concrete prerequisites or failure modes (e.g. sync_replication_slots, physical standby requirements)
Includes concrete next-turn exploration vectors with sample follow-up prompts

evals.prompt: We have an open question on whether to use SQLite WAL2 mode or standard WAL for our edge sync engine. Investigate the upstream SQLite source, design docs, and known limitations. Provide a technical dossier.
evals.expected_output: A technical dossier analyzing SQLite WAL vs WAL2 mode based on canonical SQLite documentation and source discussions, detailing checkpoint behavior and compatibility trade-offs.
assertions: Dossier contains a comparison between WAL and WAL2 modes
Explicitly identifies that WAL2 is experimental / not in the default amalgamation build
Cites sqlite.org primary docs or source repository commits
Structures findings with an executive brief, core mechanics, and next-turn exploration vectors
